highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates Skia m158 fixes for GPU failure handling, image filtering and glyph bounds.
highlights_body: This same-milestone native update does not change managed APIs or generated bindings.

bullets.detail: Propagates Ganesh draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment drops the flush's work without abandoning the context. Imagination Vulkan descriptor pools are deliberately left unfreed after allocation errors to avoid unsafe destruction.

Checks Ganesh buffer-size arithmetic and handles CPU buffer allocation failure. Rejects oversized multisample attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices rather than overflowing their footprint limits.

Prevents Ganesh image filters from incorporating unwritten scratch-texture texels and restricts destination reads to their bounds. Graphite resets depth tracking after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order.

Corrects LCD16 bitmap coordinate conversion and cropping when successive glyph loads produce different bounds. Validates bitmap dimensions and format, and guards outline translation and image-buffer bounds.
